raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The router does not expose the engine's `/abort_request` endpoint, so clients cannot cancel an in-flight request through the router.

Fixes #6531.

## Modifications

- Add `POST /abort_request` to the HTTP router.
- Forward the complete abort JSON payload and caller `Authorization` header.
- Fan the request out to every registered worker. The router has no persistent request-id-to-worker mapping, and a PD request can occupy both prefill and decode workers; non-owning workers safely treat the abort as a no-op.
- Return an empty `200 OK` when all workers acknowledge the abort (or the fleet is empty), and a per-worker `502 BAD_GATEWAY` breakdown on partial failure.
- Bound fan-out concurrency to 32 requests.
- Add unit coverage for mixed worker modes, payload preservation, authorization forwarding, partial failure, and an empty registry.
- Document the new endpoint and API-key behavior.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable; this change does not affect model outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. Abort fan-out is bounded to 32 concurrent worker requests.

## Test Plan

- `cargo fmt --manifest-path experimental/sgl-router/Cargo.toml --all -- --check` — passed.
- Added four focused Rust unit tests under `server::routes::abort::tests`.
- Local `cargo test --manifest-path experimental/sgl-router/Cargo.toml --locked abort::tests --lib` could not complete because the Windows environment does not have the MSVC `link.exe` linker; GitHub CI will perform compilation and test execution.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Accuracy and speed benchmarks are not applicable to this routing API change.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
